name: TPIsoftware Corporation
summary: TPIsoftware Corporation, a digital transformation software company, provides AI-powered software products and solutions in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers DigiLism enterprise products comprising digiRunner for enterprise API management; digiLogs for centralized log management; digiMars for big data management; digiFlexis, a business process management platform; digiRunner Cloud for AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure marketplaces; and OrientAI, an enterprise agentic AI platform.
